question: Using the hash-prozen observation-0 census of EXP-FRONTIER-39039638199 (research/experiments/EXP-FRONTIER-39039638199/run/raw/census.jsonl, sha256 45e426fd298af4cbfb7b5167a8c7498504ef6db36314053f6b3cf45c299a21ff, 1107 admitted pages with per-page structural-text and byte hashes captured 2026-10-17T15:10:35.398909Z..15:11:11.988909Z) as a genuine first observation, with the two admission defects the parent audit verified repaired by construction (a closed, fractional-second-tolerant ISO-8601 anchor parser that refuses malformed input instead of silently returning None, and a window computed on a single POSIX-epoch clock with no monotonic/epoch mixing), can an envelope-safe, checkpointed second observation certify - or explicitly refuse to certify - a zero-GET structural-text tolerance at realistic session-reuse lags inside the Director-mandated [6 h, 30 d] band, on the same four-host credential-free server-rendered documentation frame: does the accepted ~7-minute CERTIFY_BOTH_AT_0P01 bound hold as the window grows, decay into a TTL-shaped revalidation requirement whose interval is licensed by nesting, or decay into a mandatory guard; and what is the first live per-page hazard bound for the hours-to-days band that the pre-2.0 program structurally could never measure?
hypothesis: H1 (primary, window certification, pre-registered as the claim under test): for the frozen 1107-page documentation frame, at a measured separation W inside the mandated [6 h, 30 d] band, the exact one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on the per-page probability that the primary structural-text channel differs between the frozen observation-0 capture and this packet's second observation is at or below a named level L in {0.01, 0.02, 0.05} separately for the hop<=2 (SHALLOW) and hop>=3 (DEEP) strata. H2 (window-growth contrast, the decision-relevant novelty): a matched same-page, same-instrument, same-vantage comparison of the long window W against an in-launch short window of 360 s over the identical 1107 URLs either fails to separate at this power (fewer than 5 long-window-only discordant pages, exact one-sided McNemar p > 0.05) or detects positive growth (>= 5 long-window-only discordant pages at p <= 0.05); any short-window-only discordant page is declared REVERTING-CHURN evidence, i.e. a page that differed between the two in-launch observations but equalled the frozen observation-0 capture, which lowers the completeness of the differ-at-instant-W bound without making it wrong for a single reuse point. H3 (bounded negative alternative, pre-registered as an equally acceptable outcome): if either stratum's bound exceeds the coarsest grid level 0.05, or either stratum's censoring exceeds CENSOR_MAX=0.20, or either stratum's paired n falls below MIN_N_PER_STRATUM=60, or the measured window falls outside [6 h, 30 d], the packet refuses to certify and instead reports the guard requirement at its measured sensitivity. H4 (declared UNKNOWN, explicitly not tested here): JavaScript-rendered content, authenticated pages, any egress vantage other than this runner, every lag beyond the measured window W, the >72 h band unless the launch delay actually lands there, the product's chosen tolerance among 1%/2%/5%, and whether hop-depth-scoped guarding beats one global TTL in real sessions.
falsifier: The primary certification hypothesis is falsified for a stratum S when the exact one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on the structural-text change probability for S over the frozen page set at window W exceeds the coarsest grid level 0.05 (first reachable at 25/686 deep or 14/421 shallow events), or when the S censoring fraction exceeds 0.20, or when the paired n for S is below 60, or when W is outside [6 h, 30 d]. The window-growth contrast H2 is falsified (growth detected) when the exact one-sided conditional-binomial p-value for long-window-only discordant pages exceeding short-window-only discordant pages is <= 0.05; it is falsified in the opposite direction when short-window-only discordant pages dominate, which is declared reverting churn. The measurement itself is invalidated - never falsified - when any offline canary fails, when the repaired parser cannot reproduce the four frozen epoch anchors, when the anchor-consistency check fails, when the frozen census file hash does not match, when the frozen×frozen 14.4 h byte canary does not reproduce the parent's recorded value bit-for-bit, when no live positive control fires between the two in-launch observations, when any null anchor or in-frame self-pair changes, when the GET ledger does not reconcile within GET_CEILING_TOTAL=3200, or when the module's self-hash is not recorded.

baselines.role: PRIMARY matched comparator: identical pages, identical instrument, identical vantage, identical sweep policy, different separation
baselines.definition: An in-launch third observation (OBS2) of exactly the same 1107 URLs taken SHORT_SEPARATION_S=360.0 s after this packet's OBS1 sweep of the same URLs, compared against OBS1 rather than against the frozen observation-0 capture. It supplies (a) the S variable for the paired window-growth contrast, (b) an in-run non-regression demonstration that the repaired code detects text change on this very frame, and (c) a direct replication of the accepted parent's nominal separation (360 s requested; measured median 407.97 s) under this packet's code.
baselines.why_strong: It removes page set, instrument, vantage, transport, host mix, URL class and sweep order as explanations for any window difference. The only manipulated factor is the elapsed time. Its weakness is also declared: it is the second sweep of the same launch, so edge/CDN warming between the two sweeps can only suppress its sensitivity, never inflate the long window's.
baselines.cost: 1107 GETs plus a 360 s in-process sleep plus a 30 s inter-sweep politeness gap

baselines.role: inherited accepted comparator at the 7-minute window (audit PASS, Director-verified recomputation)
baselines.definition: EXP-FRONTIER-39039638199: 0 of 1107 paired pages changed text over a median 407.97 s separation; exact one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson UB95 = 0.004357435376452668 (deep, n=686) and 0.007090496587222661 (shallow, n=421); frozen label CERTIFY_BOTH_AT_0P01; audit PASS with producer_claim_supported=true. Its raw rows are a hash-pinned freeze artifact of this packet.
baselines.why_strong: It is an audited, independently recomputed measurement on exactly this page set with exactly this detector, so the window-growth statement is anchored at a real measured point rather than at an assumption.
baselines.declared_limits: Its window is 407.97 s, i.e. the seconds-to-minutes band; it says nothing about hours-to-days, and its own frozen ceiling forbids extrapolating one. It is not re-measured by this packet; it is cited, never combined arithmetically with the long window.

baselines.role: conservative sensitivity channel for the same estimand on the primary population
baselines.definition: sha256 of the raw full response body on the identical 1107 pairs, reported beside every structural-text bound. It is the channel that catches attribute-only and script-only churn which the primary channel is blind to by construction.
baselines.why_strong: A certification made only on the narrow channel would be an artefact of the detector's blindness. In the parent at the 7-minute window the two channels disagreed in exactly this way (7/1107 byte changes, all attribute/script-only, text unchanged), so the byte bound is not a formality.
baselines.inherited_reference: the parent's frozen accepted byte bounds at the short window were UB95 = 0.011264 deep and 0.021609 shallow, both above 0.01, i.e. byte-identity was NOT certifiable even at 7 minutes

baselines.role: covariate only, never a decision variable and never a validity gate
baselines.definition: ETag / Last-Modified difference on the identical pairs, reported per host, plus the count of pairs whose body_len is unchanged.
baselines.why_strong_and_why_not_a_gate: Pre-2.0 Intel cycle-8 evidence (codex/legacy_artifact_index.json artifact 4.443, sha 43d21a4a384bc5a242c6bb6f4725e4093982f0fb) established that a resource can vary bytewise under one unchanged ETag and that a per-request trace identifier can make a resource volatile without its content changing, so an ETag-only detector is demonstrably insensitive. Conversely, in the parent's own accepted raw rows all 359 of 1107 transport moves came from a single host (pandas.pydata.org Last-Modified values moving with no text change), so a 'transport must move' gate would be a host-specific artefact, not a validity condition. It is therefore reported as a covariate with a declared structural expectation, never gated.

baselines.role: SECONDARY timescale ladder on a 292-page subset of the SAME frame; can never change the primary label
baselines.definition: Three window points computed on the 292 admitted grandparent pages (research/experiments/EXP-FRONTIER-38940047535/run/raw/census.jsonl, sha256 37f3d87b49083e77b117bc5796f2ac9a3c4784e61e4acbf644a3c4fea1e487d7), which are a strict SUBSET of the primary 1107 (verified overlap 292/292, legacy-only 0): point P0 = grandparent anchor 2026-10-17T00:46:04.288Z -> frozen obs0 (about 14.4 h, byte channel, ZERO extra GETs because both endpoints are frozen); point P3 = frozen obs0 -> this packet's OBS1 on the same 292 URLs (about W, byte channel, reuses the OBS1 rows); point P4 = grandparent anchor -> this packet's OBS1 on the same 292 URLs (about W+14.4 h, byte channel, also zero extra GETs).
baselines.why_strong: It converts the parent's structurally unadmitted retrospective channel into a properly dated, three-point, same-page ladder spanning roughly a 200x range of windows, at zero marginal GET cost, and it exercises the mandated fractional-second repair on the only artifact that actually contains fractional-second timestamps.
baselines.declared_limits: byte channel only (the grandparent census carries no text_sha256), 292 pages, shallow-biased (261 shallow / 31 deep), readthedocs-heavy (168/292), and nested inside (not independent of) the primary population. It is a subset contrast, so it can never be stronger than the primary bound and must never be combined with it into a single stronger number.

baselines.role: reported two-sided exact contrast, symmetric in direction, never part of the primary label
baselines.definition: Exact conditional-binomial one-sided tails in BOTH directions for p_deep > p_shallow and p_shallow > p_deep on the identical page set at window W, plus the minimum detectable deep and shallow rates.
baselines.why_strong: The parent tested depth concentration only in the deep>shallow direction at the 7-minute window where nothing changed anywhere. At an hours window the volatile class (readthedocs, 168 pages, 140 of them shallow) makes the shallow>deep direction a live possibility, so a pre-registered one-directional test would be a rigged contrast. Reporting both directions with an MDC prevents 'no concentration detected' from being read as 'no concentration'.
baselines.declared_limits: hop depth remains confounded with host and URL class inside each stratum; the MDC is reported so that a null is never rendered as an absence

positive_control.definition: Three pre-registered volatile URLs fetched at OBS1 and again at OBS2, i.e. across the 360 s in-launch separation: https://www.cloudflare.com/cdn-cgi/trace , https://api.github.com/rate_limit , https://timeapi.io/api/Time/current/zone?timeZone=UTC . Identical set to the parent's accepted positive control; no re-selection after outcomes.
positive_control.pass_condition: M-LIVE-POS-CHANGED >= 1 AND M-LIVE-POS-OK >= 2, with the SAME frozen detector (canon()/text_sha() imported from the hash-pinned parent module) used to score them as for the frame
positive_control.selection_disclosure: Inherited verbatim from EXP-FRONTIER-39039638199, which probed a ten-URL candidate pool at DESIGN with two GETs <= 5 s apart and recorded which fired; DESIGN for THIS packet made no new selection and performed only one liveness GET per control URL (all three HTTP 200 at 2026-10-17T22:56Z), which establishes reachability, not volatility.

This is the Director's stop trigger and it is NOT a scientific negative.
positive_control.declared_scope_limit: This control spans the 360 s short window only. No live positive control can span the ~8 h primary window, because no live fetch exists at the observation-0 epoch. The primary window's residual sensitivity risk is therefore carried as validity check V13 (fetch-freshness diagnostics) rather than as a control, and is stated as a limitation, not argued away.

null_control.failure_disposition: A false positive on an external anchor is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not a discountable nuisance.

It is the direct noise-floor demonstration for the detector that scores the primary window.

parse_epoch(s, field) accepts exactly ISO-8601 instants with optional fractional seconds and an explicit Z or +/-HH:MM offset, anchored at the start of the string, with a year range check of 2000..2100, and RAISES ValueError on anything else - including on a non-string, a missing field, a trailing-only match or a string without a timezone designator. The parent's frozen parse() did the opposite: it returned None silently for '2026-10-17T15:10:35.398909+00:00' (because that string does not end in Z) and raised ValueError for '2026-10-17T00:45:32.184Z'. Both failure modes are now hard failures that name the offending anchor field.

Every duration in this packet is computed from POSIX-epoch seconds only. time.monotonic() is used solely for per-stage wall-budget accounting and is never subtracted from, or added to, an epoch value. The prohibited construction is demonstrated at DESIGN to be catastrophic: mixing this process's monotonic clock with the grandparent epoch anchor yields a median window of about -497832 h, which is the artefact the parent audit verified (recorded -497831.608 h).

Four independent frozen artifacts must agree on the observation-0 epoch before any window may be computed: (a) research/experiments/EXP-FRONTIER-39039638199/run/raw/PROGRESS.json started_utc = 2026-10-17T15:10:35.398909+00:00; (b) the same packet's provenance.json commands[0].started_utc, which DESIGN verified is byte-identical to (a) with delta 0.000000000 s; (c) freeze.json frozen_at 2026-10-17T14:46:23.389566Z, which must be <= the observation-0 start; (d) provenance.json commands[0].died_utc 2026-10-17T15:18:18.715476Z, which must be >= the observation-0 end. The observation-0 window end is (a) + PROGRESS.obs0.wall_s = 36.59 s.

The population is exactly the 1107 admitted rows of the hash-pinned census (status 200 with a non-null text_sha256), unique by URL, with hop and host carried from the same rows. The 12 excluded rows (6x HTTP 404, 6x malformed-URL transport errors) are reported in M-N-EXCLUDED-OBS0 with their exact reasons and are never re-admitted. No page is discovered, crawled or added: this packet re-fetches a frozen population and nothing else.

The observation-0 rows carry only the parent process's monotonic t_start/t_end, which are not convertible to epoch. The window is therefore resolved at OBSERVATION granularity, not from per-page obs0 stamps. Because the imported fetch() may not be modified, each live fetch is wrapped so that time.time() is read immediately BEFORE and immediately AFTER the parent fetch call, giving every OBS1 and OBS2 page its own epoch bracket [epoch_pre, epoch_post] on the same POSIX clock. Per page: dt_h_min(p) = (epoch_pre(p) - observation-0 window END)/3600 and dt_h_max(p) = (epoch_post(p) - observation-0 window START)/3600. The admission gate uses W = min over pages of dt_h_min(p), the most conservative single number available; M-W-H-PRIMARY-MEDIAN and M-W-H-PRIMARY-MAX are reported alongside. Every bound built on the window is stated at the admitted W. The observation-side quantisation is 36.59 s, which DESIGN computed as 0.131 percent of a 7.76 h window, and the fetch-side bracket is at most the 12 s REQUEST_TIMEOUT plus transfer time, which only widens the interval in the conservative direction.
measurement_validity.failure_disposition: n/a - disclosed as representation loss; it is small, quantified and always in the conservative direction

measurement_validity.rule: The measured dt_h_min must lie in the Director-mandated band [MIN_WINDOW_H=6.0 h, MAX_WINDOW_D*24=720 h]. Inside the band the window is labelled with an explicit sub-band: HOURS [6, 24), DAY [24, 72), DAYS [72, 720]. The sub-band is part of the primary label as an informational suffix __BAND_<name> and is never used to strengthen or weaken the bound. The 30 d ceiling corresponds to the hard deadline 2026-11-16T15:11:11.988909Z; after it the packet's own refusal branch fires and its persisted OBS1 rows become the anchor for a successor transaction.

OBS2 pairs enter the short-window comparison only when their measured OBS1->OBS2 separation is >= DT_MIN_S=300 s and <= DT_MAX_S=900 s, a timestamp-only and outcome-independent rule. Pairs below the floor are counted in M-SHORT-N-PAIR-EXCLUDED-BELOW-DT-MIN and never analysed at too short a lag. DESIGN computed the expected separation as about 430-440 s for every page, inside the admitted range.
measurement_validity.failure_disposition: the short-window channel is reported with its exclusions; if fewer than 60 pairs per stratum survive, the growth contrast is labelled UNDERPOWERED and is not computed

measurement_validity.rule: Pages that were 200 at observation 0 but are not 200 at OBS1 are right-censored for the change estimand and are never counted as unchanged and never counted as changed. Per stratum M-CENSOR-FRAC-S must not exceed CENSOR_MAX=0.20 or that stratum refuses certification. HTTP 404/410 are reported separately as M-DEAD-404-S with their own bound M-DEAD-UB95-S; 429/403/503 are reported separately as M-RATE-LIMITED-S. Offline injections prove the primary channel fires on a visible-text change (C-DETECT-TEXT-INJECTION) and is blind by construction and by test to attribute-only and script-only churn (C-DETECT-ATTR-ONLY, C-DETECT-SCRIPT-ONLY). The blind spot is quantified live as M-CHANGE-ATTR-ONLY-S and bounded as M-HAZARD-BYTE-UB95-S. In the parent's accepted raw rows the byte channel produced exactly 7 attribute/script-only changes with zero text changes, so this channel is known to bind.

M-HOST-TABLE reports every host's paired n per stratum; M-HOSTS-WITH-BOTH-STRATA counts hosts with >= MIN_HOST_STRATUM_N=25 pages in BOTH strata; M-HOST-CONC-MAX-S flags a stratum supplied >= HOST_CONC_WARN=0.60 by one host; M-CLASS-FRAC-{VERSION_PINNED,MOVING_ALIAS,OTHER}-S reports immutability composition and a stratum that is >= VERSION_PINNED_FRAC_WARN=0.80 version-pinned is tagged BOUNDED_TO_VERSION_PINNED because a zero there would be true by construction. The frozen population has deep 686 / shallow 421 with all four hosts spanning both strata, max host concentration 0.321 deep and 0.333 shallow, and version-pinned share 0.032 deep and 0.002 shallow, so the frame is neither host-concentrated nor a version-pinned ceiling.

No live positive control can span the ~8 h primary window because no live fetch exists at the observation-0 epoch, so a stale or cached OBS1 response would be indistinguishable from a stable page at the text channel. L1-WINDOW-NESTING is a frozen structural lemma, not a fitted regularity: for a FIXED page set, a FIXED detector and FIXED status-200-at-both-ends, the event 'the structural text at instant t2 differs from the text at instant t1' is monotone increasing in t2 - t1. Therefore (i) a certification at the largest measured window W implies certification at every smaller window on the same page set, and (ii) an upper bound at W bounds every smaller window. Consequences: M-TTL-LICENSED-LAG-H is exactly the largest measured window for the population and stratum concerned, and NOTHING may be claimed beyond it. The lemma is verified offline on synthetic monotone schedules (C-NESTING-LEMMA-CANARY) and it is explicitly void where reverting churn exists, which is why the short-window channel is measured and its short-window-only discordant pages are reported.
measurement_validity.failure_disposition: n/a - a false lemma would be a derivation defect caught by C-NESTING-LEMMA-CANARY

decision_rule.form: Total, ordered, disjoint function decide(m) over frozen metrics only. Frozen reference implementation and the frozen canary table are in prereg.md#12; the executed module must implement exactly that rule and AUDIT re-runs the 22 C-DECIDE-LONG-* canaries against the module's own decide(). No branch depends on anything outside m, and no branch can be manufactured by redefining a metric after outcomes are visible because every threshold is frozen in the hash-pinned preregistration.
decision_rule.step_0_input_and_control_validity: If not control_ok (any offline canary failed, or the repaired parser cannot reproduce the four frozen epoch anchors, or the anchor-consistency check failed, or the frozen census hash mismatched, or the frozen-by-frozen 14.4 h byte canary failed to reproduce, or no live positive control fired, or any null anchor or in-frame self-pair changed) or not obs0_integrity_ok -> label NO_DATA_CONTROL_OR_INPUT_FAIL, status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE. This is never a scientific negative. Else if the GET ledger does not reconcile within GET_CEILING_TOTAL -> NO_DATA_LEDGER_FAIL, status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE.
decision_rule.step_1_frozen_frame_power: Else if n_deep < 60 or n_shallow < 60 -> REFUSE_LONG_INSUFFICIENT_N, status=COMPLETE, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE.
decision_rule.step_2_window_admission: Else if W = dt_h_min is None or W < 6.0 h -> REFUSE_LONG_WINDOW_BELOW_BAND, status=COMPLETE, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE. Else if W > 720 h -> REFUSE_LONG_WINDOW_ABOVE_BAND, status=COMPLETE, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE. Else set band = HOURS if W < 24, DAY if W < 72, else DAYS.
